assumptions.source: Explicit, legal saved-character fixtures, not measured live cohorts.
assumptions.gear: Rare armor/weapon at 30; dropped step-3 upgrades from 35; epic step-3 weapon at 50; legendary armor, gloves and specialty weapon from 65; mythic weapon from 80; legal mid-roll named armor/gloves/weapon from 90.
assumptions.ownership: All equipment is owned and sealed through sealTowerFighter; effectiveItemLevelReq checked for each piece.
assumptions.level70: Five Legendary armor pieces (35% raw armor pool), Legendary gloves, 6% derived item damage, discipline-appropriate 22-EP weapon. Gloves grant no armor reduction.
assumptions.named: 25.5 EP, range 4, 174 all-offense weapon and legal single 35% Increase Damage Given roll; Legendary-quality armor 30 offense/defense (75 offense gloves), 1.13% damage per piece.
assumptions.highRoll: 27 EP, range 5, 180 all-offense, single 40% IDG; Mythic-quality armor, 35 stats (85 offense gloves), 1.5% damage each. Used for the optimized Elite-finale release check; ordinary mid-roll Elite results remain separate diagnostics.
assumptions.alternates: Crimson/forged mid-roll lifesteal and Ironwall/forged mid-roll shield profiles.
assumptions.training: Exactly earnedForLevel(level) points above base10, archetype priorities from aiStatsForLevel, redistributed within statCapForLevel; actual rank, exams and zero unspent points. Production hydrator adds authoritative gear bonuses separately.
assumptions.controller: Coordinates focus fire, mandatory guards, active Barrier/terrain/hazard escape, pylons, healing, Clear and Cleanse, actual equipped weapon cooldown/range/AP, 40-AP utility and 60-AP catalog techniques. Uses canonical Lag-adjusted AP and Elemental Seal eligibility.
assumptions.launch: Selected route, PvE guard, opening/delayed/summoned enemy mastery use the production setup.
assumptions.seeds: 101 + (index + offset) * 7919; 12 per base cell; independent finale seeds use offset 12 and 24 seeds.

gates.normal: >=70% F1-14; >=50% F15; 5-24 average terminal rounds; F1 >=90% squad and <=10% solo; F1 mean remaining squad HP <80%.
gates.eliteCheckpoints: >=50% for all five compositions at F3/F9 with progression gear and at the level-100 F15 with optimized high-roll forged gear; 5-26 average rounds. Ordinary mid-roll Elite results are retained, including weaker homogeneous compositions. Elite modifiers remain 18% HP and 10% damage.
gates.rankProgression: All compositions: F5 >=8 average rounds, F7 >=7, F10 >=10. Mixed HP ceilings F5/F7 80%, F10 85%, F13/F14 75%, F15 50%. Final stricter pressure recheck passed.
gates.openingHits: Actual catalog jutsu and equipped weapons tested against opening, delayed and summoned ordinary enemies, including high-roll forged loadouts from level 90. No tested unbuffed opener one-shots an on-level ordinary enemy.

supersededBaseline.classification: Historical lower-power fixture; superseded as the expected level-70/endgame gear assumption. Its enemy HP curve and controller also precede this calibration.

precedingGearCalibration.classification: Superseded before the owner clarified the 30–100 rank climb: middle bosses were too brief and high-rank enemy composites lagged. These old clear rates are not the final curve.

precedingControllerCalibration.classification: Superseded controller: Barrier paths, Lag AP, Elemental Seal and Cleanse counterplay were incomplete. These are not the final curve outcomes.

limitations: Engine-controlled coordinated players are not a production win-rate estimate.
Gear upgrades are expected preparation; no additional gear gate or per-floor level lock is imposed.
Individual optimized builds and earlier-floor returns may outperform these fixtures; no artificial player damage cap was added.
Local network evidence and exact deployed-commit verification have separate scope in battle-towers-multiplayer-certification-results.json.
